description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2147/22 of 31.10.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification amends regulations under the Finance Act, No. 35 of 2018, specifically modifying the procedures for amending Letters of Credit for vehicle imports. It contains legal/regulatory content about import regulations, compliance requirements, and statutory procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content rather than being the primary focus of the gazette.
